source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Ιουλίου — «Όσιος Φώτιος κτήτορας της Μονής Ακαπνίου στη Θεσσαλονίκη»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. He is none of the corpus's five other men of the name — of Constantinople, of Kyiv, of Nicomedia, of Yuriev, and the companion of Cyril — all of whom carry a century and a story; this one has neither, and the Akapniou foundation at Thessalonica is what the calendar names him by. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The page prints no hymn: it reports that an idiomelon poem by Demetrius Beaskos stands beside his memory in the Lavriotic codex, and does not print its text.
